split_strategy: Manual. The new failure modes vs find-marketing-agency are sibling-coordination going UPSTREAM (N1 broader marketing → defer to find-marketing-agency, N2 PPC/paid-search → not SEO) and indirect SEO intent (P7 'organic traffic flat', P10 'improve Google rankings'). Those go in train. Validation tests generalization across remaining sub-flavors and out-of-scope shapes.
passing_rule: should_trigger=true → trigger_rate > 0.5 over 3 runs. should_trigger=false → trigger_rate ≤ 0.5.
